_README: Copy to data/reapers.json and edit. That path is gitignored: it records what is
being watched and how much is behind it, and this repository is public.
Balances are ring-fences. A lane may lose its balance and nothing else, and the
breakers derive the per-position cap and the daily loss limit from it.
Every lane stops at a sized instruction. Nothing here places a bet, submits an
order or signs a transaction, and the crypto adapter has no key path at all.
Theses live separately in data/theses.json and must be written by a person. The
stocks and crypto lanes refuse a watchlist entry that has none.

_autonomous_execution: Whether this lane PLACES ITS OWN INSTRUCTIONS. Absent means no — autonomy is
asserted, never assumed, so a missing key or a typo can never resolve to placing
freely. Only the literal true grants it; "true" as a string does not.
Two switches override it, and both beat this file because a switch a setting could
override would not be a switch:
data/MANUAL          every lane drops to owner-operating; lanes keep running
python run.py --resume "Your Name" "what you checked"   hand it back
Taking the wheel does NOT stop the research. Every lane still looks, screens,
gates, authorises and sizes; only the placing waits for you. HALT is the one that
_quota: The odds API charges per region and per market, and up to ten NAMED books cost
what one region costs. So "bookmakers" below halves the price of every scan
against the default uk,eu — which matters on a free tier of 500 credits with the
arb lane running every thirty minutes.
It is commented out rather than set, and that is deliberate. Naming books narrows
what you looked at, and a book that is misspelled, retired, or not carried in this
region comes back as a 200 with that book simply absent. The lane then reports a
quiet market from a narrower look than you chose, with no error anywhere. Set it
when you know which books you can actually place at, and check "books_requested"
against "books" in scan_arb --json the first time.
Omit it and the whole uk,eu region is scanned, which costs more and hides nothing.
_limits: The ring-fence is all this lane may lose. Everything below is derived from it:
per_position_pct 5      one position may be 25.00 of the 500 balance
max_deployed_pct 40     no more than 200.00 may be OUT AT ONCE
daily_loss_pct 3        15.00 of settled losses in a day trips the lane
The standing grant's max_exposure must fit INSIDE per_position_pct, or every slip
sizes to something the breakers then refuse. A test asserts that for this file.
max_deployed_pct is the one the per-position cap never bounded. Eight positions at
5% is 40% of the ring-fence out at once, and for a lane whose bets settle on Sunday
that is a normal Saturday rather than an accident.
_authority: A standing grant, because nobody writes a thesis per football match at nine in
the morning. Defensible HERE and nowhere else in this repository: an arb makes
no claim about the fixture. Every minted thesis records that nobody looked at
the particular market before authorising it.

authority.reasoning: two books disagree by more than the cost of taking both sides; this position makes no claim about the event's outcome
considered: a soft book restricts or limits the account, which is routine rather than a tail risk
one leg is voided and the other stands, leaving an unhedged single bet
the price moves between placing the first leg and the second

_declarations: The lane's ceiling is INDETERMINATE until one of these exists for the books it
wants to use. An odds feed returns odds, not settlement terms, and the only real
position this board examined had a positive margin and voided on one leg only.
The key is the books that will be PLACED, sorted and joined with |. Run the lane
once with none and it tells you the exact key it wants. A declaration is a
one-time act per set of books: read their abandonment and non-runner rules once.
'*' matches any books. It exists, it is deliberately awkward to reach for, and a
declaration that two unnamed books settle alike is not a judgement anybody made.

Sky Bet|bet365.reasoning: read both books' football rules for abandonment and non-runners; both void the market and return stakes if the fixture is not replayed within 48 hours

_watchlist: The lane disqualifies; it does not select. These are companies YOU chose and
wrote a thesis for. The filings are used to knock them out, not to find them.

_README: A FORECAST lane, and the only one in this repository. It says a book's price is
WRONG, which is a claim about the fixture — unlike the arb lane, which says two
prices cannot both be right and needs no view at all. If the model is wrong about
a fixture the whole stake is lost. Read lib/mispricing.py before enabling it.
Disabled by default for two reasons and both are money:
1. It buys the SAME h2h prices from the SAME odds key as the arb lane. The free
tier is 500 requests a month. Check `python preflight.py` before enabling —
it prints what both lanes spend together against the allowance.
2. The model ships as PAPER and cannot size anything until a named person has
read enough settled predictions to promote it. That is not a formality: a
model can satisfy every other guard here and still simply be bad, and only
time and a ledger find that out.
_competitions: football-data.org competition codes for the league tables. Free key at
football-data.org, saved to ~/.footballdata/key. With none, every fixture is
reported UNPRICED naming the strengths it could not get, which is the correct
_team_aliases: The odds feed says 'Manchester United'; football-data says 'Manchester United FC'.
Suffixes like FC are stripped automatically. Anything else is an alias you record
here once — matching is exact on purpose, because a fuzzy matcher that is right
95% of the time models the wrong team's goals one fixture in twenty with no signal.
_venues: Market name -> ground, so the weather can be looked up (open-meteo, no key). Omit
and the weather features report UNKNOWN, which the forecast carries as an
assumption rather than as a still, dry evening.

_note: A forecasting model is a FORECAST and needs a named human, exactly as
lib/stocks_reaper.Criterion's FORECAST criterion does. It cannot be declared by
an agent and construction refuses one that tries.
stated_error_pct is in PROBABILITY POINTS and it is mandatory. An edge inside it
is reported FAIR, not 'a small edge'. 4.0 is a deliberately unflattering figure
for a Poisson model with no expected-goals data and no team news: independent
Poisson is known to under-predict draws, and the book prices the team news that
status is PAPER until a person writes promoted_on. LIVE without it is refused.
model.name: poisson-league-goals-v1
model.reasoning: league scoring rates and home advantage, against the book's de-vigged price; the claim is that a book's shorter prices on mid-table fixtures carry more margin than its headline overround suggests
